This page highlights recent professional milestones, research activities, conference presentations, publications, awards, funding, and other updates from my work in population data science, administrative data research, and Trusted Research Environments (TREs).

## November 2026

### 🎤 Invited to Present FRAME-DS at the CaSDaR Hybrid Data Steward Conference 2026

Invited to present [FRAME-DS: Framework for Recognising Applied Data Stewardship Within TRE Workforces](https://casdar.ac.uk/announcing-the-results-of-casdars-funding-call-round-1/){target="_blank"} at the [CaSDaR Hybrid Data Steward Conference 2026](https://casdar.ac.uk/event/casdars-hybrid-data-steward-conference-2026/){target="_blank"} at [The Midland, Manchester](https://www.themidlandhotel.co.uk/){target="_blank"}, on **17–18 November 2026**. The conference brings together data stewards, researchers, research technical professionals, and research infrastructure leaders from across the UK to share best practice, showcase funded projects, and shape the future of data stewardship.

## September 2026

### 📝 Accepted PhD Offer at Edinburgh Napier University

Accepted an unconditional offer to undertake a [PhD in Health and Social Care](https://www.napier.ac.uk/research-and-innovation/doctoral-college/phd){target="_blank"} at [Edinburgh Napier University](https://www.napier.ac.uk/about-us/our-schools/the-school-of-health-and-social-care){target="_blank"}, commencing in **October 2026**. The PhD is supported by an Edinburgh Napier University studentship. My research project, [Using Nationally Representative Data to Understand the Nursing and Midwifery Professions in the United Kingdom](https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/using-nationally-representative-data-to-understand-the-nursing-and-midwifery-professions-in-the-united-kingdom-shsc0061/?p184975){target="_blank"}, will use nationally representative data to investigate the nursing and midwifery professions in the UK and generate evidence to inform workforce research, policy, and planning. The PhD will be supervised by [Professor Iain Atherton](https://napier-repository.worktribe.com/person/111326/iain-atherton){target="_blank"}, [Dr William L. Palmer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-william-l-palmer-74641b3/){target="_blank"}, and [Dr Martin Sharp](https://napier-repository.worktribe.com/person/2878950/dr-martin-sharp){target="_blank"}.

## June 2026

### 📢 Presented FRAME-DS to the SDAP Community

Presented [FRAME-DS (Framework for Recognising Applied Data Stewardship Within TRE Workforces](https://securedatagroup.org/events/2026-2/){target="_blank"} to the [Secure Data Access Professionals (SDAP)](https://securedatagroup.org/){target="_blank"} community. ## March 2026

### 💷 Awarded UKRI CaSDaR Funding as Principal Investigator

Awarded **£64,508.43** as Principal Investigator for **FRAME-DS: Framework for Recognising Applied Data Stewardship Within TRE Workforces**, one of four projects selected from 24 applications through the UKRI-funded [CaSDaR Network+](https://casdar.ac.uk/announcing-the-results-of-casdars-funding-call-round-1/){target="_blank"}. Delivered collaboratively by [Research Data Scotland](https://www.researchdata.scot/){target="_blank"} and [Electronic Data Research and Innovation Service (eDRIS)](https://publichealthscotland.scot/resources-and-tools/health-intelligence-and-data-management/electronic-data-research-and-innovation-service-edris/overview/what-is-edris/){target="_blank"} at [Public Health Scotland](https://publichealthscotland.scot/){target="_blank"}, FRAME-DS focuses on recognising and strengthening applied data stewardship across Trusted Research Environments (TREs).

### 🔗 Completed Privacy-Preserving Record Linkage Workshop

Participated in the [Privacy-Preserving Record Linkage Workshop](https://www.adruk.org/news-publications/events/events/privacy-preserving-record-linkage-workshop/){target="_blank"} delivered by [ADR Scotland](https://www.adrscotland.org/){target="_blank"} on **3–4 June 2025** at the [Edinburgh Futures Institute](https://efi.ed.ac.uk/){target="_blank"}, [University of Edinburgh](https://www.ed.ac.uk/){target="_blank"}. ## December 2024

### 📊 Achieved RSS Data Analyst Status

Awarded [Data Analyst](https://rss.org.uk/membership/professional-register/){target="_blank"} status by the Royal Statistical Society.

## November 2024

### 📚 Completed Introduction to Administrative Data Research and Analysis (IADRA)

Completed the [Introduction to Administrative Data Research and Analysis (IADRA)](https://www.adrscotland.org/training-support/introduction-to-administrative-data-research-and-analysis-iadra/){target="_blank"} course delivered by [ADR Scotland](https://www.adrscotland.org/){target="_blank"}. The four-week programme combined expert-led lectures with practical R exercises using synthetic data from the [Scottish Longitudinal Study (SLS)](https://sls.lscs.ac.uk/){target="_blank"}, covering data provenance, record linkage, data quality, visualisation, and analysis of linked administrative data.

## September 2024

### 🧬 Completed Workshop on Synthetic Data and Synthpop

Participated in the [Synthetic Data Workshop](https://www.researchdata.scot/news-and-insights/synthetic-data-workshop-5-september-2024/){target="_blank"}, led by [Professor Gillian Raab](https://sls.lscs.ac.uk/about/the-sls-team/prof-gillian-raab/){target="_blank"} on **5 September 2024**. The hands-on workshop introduced the [`synthpop`](https://www.synthpop.org.uk/){target="_blank"} package in R and covered the creation of synthetic versions of confidential datasets, low- and high-fidelity synthetic data, and practical approaches to data confidentiality. The workshop strengthened my understanding of synthetic data generation and its responsible use in research environments, particularly for supporting data privacy, reproducibility, and safe access to sensitive data.

### 🔬 Joined Research Data Scotland

Joined [Research Data Scotland](https://www.researchdata.scot/){target="_blank"} as a [Data Analyst](https://www.researchdata.scot/about-rds/our-people/){target="_blank"}, supporting the preparation, documentation, governance, and reuse of administrative datasets for research within Scotland's National Safe Haven. My work focuses on metadata, synthetic data, reproducible analytical pipelines, and research data infrastructure that support population and social science research.

## August 2024

### 📊 Completed Workshop on Efficient Large-Scale Data Processing in R

Participated in the workshop **“Processing Large-Scale Data Efficiently: An Introduction to the R Package `data.table`”**, delivered by [Dr Andreas Hoehn](https://www.gla.ac.uk/schools/healthwellbeing/staff/andreashoehn/){target="_blank"} on **15 August 2024**. The workshop covered efficient data manipulation, memory management, benchmarking, parallel processing, and practical techniques for working with large datasets in R. The training strengthened my use of [`data.table`](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/){target="_blank"} for high-performance data processing and helped improve the efficiency of analytical workflows involving large datasets. [Workshop materials, slides, and code examples are available on GitHub](https://github.com/AndreasxHoehn/2024_RDS_DT){target="_blank"}.

## September 2023

### 🏥 Joined the University of Edinburgh

Joined the [University of Edinburgh](https://www.ed.ac.uk/){target="_blank"} as a [Health Data Analyst](https://edwebprofiles.ed.ac.uk/profile/linus-chirchir){target="_blank"}, developing reproducible R and SQL pipelines for linked NHS datasets and supporting research into patient outcomes and healthcare services. I also developed interactive dashboards and contributed to data governance, metadata standardisation, and research data management activities.

## July 2023

### 🎓 Graduated with an MSc in Health Data Science

Graduated from [Swansea University](https://www.swansea.ac.uk/){target="_blank"} with an [MSc in Health Data Science](https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/health-data-science-msc-pgdip-pgcert/){target="_blank"}. The programme strengthened my interests in population data science, administrative data research, machine learning, and reproducible analytics. My dissertation applied machine learning methods to investigate the prediction of early-stage Alzheimer's disease using the [OASIS-3](https://sites.wustl.edu/oasisbrains/home/oasis-3/){target="_blank"} dataset.

## January 2022

### 🚀 Began MSc in Health Data Science

Started the [MSc in Health Data Science](https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/health-data-science-msc-pgdip-pgcert/){target="_blank"} at [Swansea University](https://www.swansea.ac.uk/){target="_blank"}, marking my transition into population data science, administrative data research, machine learning, and advanced statistical analysis. The programme provided training in health informatics, epidemiology, statistics, machine learning, and population data science, laying the foundation for my subsequent work in Trusted Research Environments, synthetic data, metadata, and research data infrastructure.
